description: Commission of Elections - Declared Mr. Abbas Alikhan Shariff elected as a member of the Northern Province Provincial  Council from the Administrative District of Mannar
categorisation: This gazette notification specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in the Northern Province Provincial Council due to a resignation. It involves the electoral process, including the notification of vacancy by the Provincial Council Secretary, the requirement for a political party to nominate a replacement, and the formal declaration by the Election Commission of a new member being elected. This content falls squarely under electoral processes and related matters, making it an Elections Gazette.
